en.headline: Mainland arrivals pass golden week forecast in six days
en.dek: Immigration Department figures put mainland visitor arrivals at 1.3 million in the first six days, above the 1.29 million forecast for the full holiday.
body: Mainland visitor arrivals in the first six days of the National Day holiday reached 1.3 million, already above the Immigration Department's forecast of 1.29 million for the whole week, the South China Morning Post reported on Thursday, citing department figures.
The total was 11.6 per cent higher than the same period last year. The department had earlier expected about 1.29 million mainland arrivals across the seven-day break, which ran from 1 to 7 October.

Echo Huang Shaomei, executive director and chief executive of New World Development, said footfall at K11 Musea set a record for a National Day golden week, and that tourist spending there rose 26 per cent from a year earlier. She said jewellery and watches remained popular with mainland visitors, including one transaction of nearly 2 million dollars.
The holiday has now ended. The figures cover arrivals, not how long visitors stayed or how much they spent citywide.

zh.headline: 內地訪港六日已超黃金周預測
zh.dek: 入境處數字顯示，國慶假期首六日內地旅客達一百三十萬人次，高於整周一百二十九萬的預測，按年升百分之十一點六。
body: 《南華早報》周四引述入境事務處數字報道，國慶假期首六日，內地訪港旅客達一百三十萬人次，已高於當局對整周假期一百二十九萬人次的預測。
該數字較去年同期上升百分之十一點六。入境處早前估計，十月一日至七日的七天假期，內地旅客約一百二十九萬人次。
新世界發展執行董事兼行政總裁黃少美說，尖沙咀K11 Musea在這個國慶黃金周的人流創下同期紀錄，旅客消費按年增加百分之二十六。她說珠寶及手錶仍受內地旅客歡迎，其中一宗交易近二百萬元。
假期現已結束。上述數字只計入境人次，並未反映旅客留港日數，亦非全港消費總額。
